meta.source: UN Comtrade / WTO Statistics / World Bank Trade (curated 2021-2023)
limitations: Annual data only. Monthly available via UN Comtrade Plus API.
2021-2022 values scaled from 2023 base using commodity price adjustment (~1.8% / ~12.4%).
Myanmar post-2021: sparse data, estimates from IMF/WB proxies.
Brunei: oil/LNG dominant; bilateral figures are approximate.
EU aggregate: covers all 27 EU member states combined.
Exports: FOB. Imports: CIF (~5-10% higher). Affects trade balance.
meta.dependency_formula: partner_share = (exports_to_partner + imports_from_partner) / (total_exports + total_imports). >40% = high, 20-40% = medium, <20% = low.
meta.refresh_note: Run 'cd pipeline && python fetch_comtrade.py' with COMTRADE_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY in .env for live UN Comtrade Plus API data.
